claims.text: Anthropic's C compiler project used 16 agents, about 2,000 sessions, 2B input tokens and 140M output tokens, costing just under $20,000.
Uber reduced cost per 1,000 requests by about 34% from its peak.
Uber reduced cost per session by 52% with the model held constant.
Uber moved interactive sessions to a 1-hour prompt-cache TTL.
Uber keeps a 5-minute prompt-cache TTL for subagents.
Uber compacts context at 400K tokens even on models with a 1M-token context window.
Uber sends spend alerts at 50%, 80% and 100% thresholds.
Uber models agent spend as users x sessions per user x turns per session x requests per turn x tokens per request x price per token.
